design_note.minsa: Added as engineering research candidate, not as trusted religious source.
design_note.ontology: OWL/RDF can model relationships and support SPARQL, but cannot manufacture fiqh conclusions; every derived claim remains tied to source evidence.
design_note.embeddings: Embeddings are retrieval infrastructure, not truth or authority; evidence IDs, provenance, rights and verification status must persist through retrieval.
design_note.llm: LLM weights can assist synthesis only after the evidence gate and never replace source-grounded evidence or scholar review.
design_note.arena: Arena is an optional external coding-agent worker; repository access must remain least-privilege and all changes flow through isolated branches, tests, evidence and review.
design_note.agent_fleet: Multiple agents are capability workers, not authorities. Rechercher Ω remains the orchestrator; no agent may write directly to the canonical Corpus.
design_note.islamic_graphs: Islamic knowledge-graph projects are research inputs only. Preserve source IDs, provenance, rights and uncertainty through graph construction and retrieval.
design_note.mcp_grounding: MCP servers are connector/query infrastructure, not religious authorities. Rechercher must retain source IDs, exact text, edition/language metadata, provenance, rights and retrieval evidence.
design_note.manuscript_ocr: Maghrebi and manuscript OCR resources can improve acquisition and transcription, but OCR output remains a derived artifact requiring multi-engine comparison and human/QC validation before canonical use.
design_note.quran_audio_alignment: Quran ASR and Tadabur provide recitation transcription/timing research inputs. Audio, transcripts, model weights and timing annotations remain distinct derived/source layers with separate rights and provenance.
design_note.htr_stack: eScriptorium plus Kraken strengthen the manuscript OCR/HTR lane. Rechercher should preserve page images, line segmentation, recognition outputs, model/version metadata and human corrections, then require multi-engine agreement/QC before promotion.
design_note.deterministic_quran_analysis: Exact counting and search tools are evidence-processing infrastructure only. Preserve canonical Quran text separately from morphology, frequency claims, ontology relations and generated answers.
design_note.registry_dedup: Canonicalize research-source entries by URL. When an existing project later gains richer metadata, merge into the original entry instead of creating a second ID.
design_note.arabic_nlp: CAMeL Tools can provide reusable Arabic linguistic preprocessing, but model/data packages are not assumed to inherit the toolkit's MIT license.
design_note.local_retrieval: Qdrant is a candidate self-hosted vector layer; every point should carry source/work/edition/language/provenance/rights identifiers so retrieval never detaches evidence metadata.
design_note.local_inference: llama.cpp is runtime infrastructure only. Rechercher Ω selects models separately and applies the model repository/weights license gate before inference assets are admitted.
design_note.arabic_book_ocr: Arabic-Nougat adds a book-page OCR path producing structured Markdown. Because its README presents code/model/data licensing separately and includes differing license references, it remains review_required until each artifact is individually verified.
design_note.arabic_manuscript_htr_2026: Ketaba-OCR-LoRA is a current Arabic manuscript HTR research candidate. Rechercher should use it as a derived transcription worker only; no OCR output becomes canonical without multi-engine comparison, page provenance, checksum and human/QC review.
